scene: Rooftops overlook Bathhouse Chimney Street, where three curious departures await your journey.
picture: A flat rooftop boardwalk running left to right under chimney steam. On the far left sits a green ivy-draped tram on elevated rails. To the left stands the grandfather pushing his bicycle with potted plants. In the centre waits a red bento-shaped monorail carriage with open doors. On the far right, a giant wooden koi boat bobs in an elevated aqueduct.
shown: a green tram car covered in flowering ivy parked at the far left platform
a shiny red bento-shaped monorail carriage with doors open in the centre
a large koi-shaped boat moored at the rooftop canal lock on the far right
